name: Preparation of a Standard Solution
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT laboratory manual landing resources; exact Class 11 practical and page to verify
educational_goal: Practice accurate weighing, dissolution, transfer, and dilution while preparing a solution of known concentration.
safety_notes: Wear goggles and follow the reagent label.
Use a pipette filler rather than mouth pipetting.
